title: Lijie Guo
text:
About me
My research focuses on hydrological and crop modelling, agricultural hydrology, irrigation management, and climate adaptation strategies for sustainable food production systems. My current work integrates impact-based drought prediction and large-sample hydrological datasets to enhance the understanding, prediction, and management of water and agricultural systems under changing environmental conditions. I am also interested in precision and smart agriculture, as well as remote sensing applications in hydrology and agriculture.

Professional Credentials

Engineer-in-Training (EIT), Association of Professional Engineers and Geoscientists of Saskatchewan (APEGS)
Associate Agrologist (AAg), Saskatchewan Institute of Agrologists (SIA)
